skills.name: canvas-design

skills.name: brainstorming

skills.name: algorithmic-art

skills.name: slack-gif-creator

skills.name: design-taste-frontend
skills.tagline_zh: 前端专用品味包：字距、留白、层级的洁癖清单。

skills.desc_en: Anti-slop frontend skill for landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns. The agent reads the brief, infers the right design direction, and ships interfaces that do not look templated. Real design systems when applicable, audit-first on redesigns, strict pre-flight check.
skills.why_zh: 把「看起来贵」拆成可执行规则，照着改三处，页面气质就不一样。

skills.name: baoyu-comic

skills.why_zh: 分镜和台词的提示词打磨得很细，出图有叙事感，不是贴图拼盘。

skills.name: caveman

skills.why_en: A joke that became a product — real token savings (claimed 65%), and it cures verbosity as a side effect.

skills.name: Generative-Media-Skills
skills.tagline_zh: 图、视频、音频三修的生成技能包，接主流模型一站出片。
skills.tagline_en: Image, video and audio generation skills in one pack, wired to mainstream models.

skills.name: Claude-Code-Game-Studios
skills.tagline_zh: 一个人 + Claude Code = 一间游戏工作室：策划、美术、程序全包。

skills.why_zh: 把游戏开发拆成可指挥的流水线角色，独立开发者照着走真能出 demo，野心和完成度都在线。
skills.why_en: Splits gamedev into commandable roles; solo devs actually ship demos with it.

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.tagline_zh: 专治 AI 生成页面那股一眼假的「模板味」。
skills.tagline_en: The cure for that instantly-recognizable AI template look.

skills.why_zh: 一整套设计令牌和排版纪律，让输出有主见：字体、留白、层级全是硬约束，不是口号。
skills.why_en: Design tokens plus typographic discipline as hard constraints — opinionated output, not vibes.

skills.name: brand-guidelines
skills.tagline_zh: 把品牌规范喂给它，从此每份产出都不跑偏。
skills.tagline_en: Feed it your brand book; every output stays on-brand after that.
skills.desc_en: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.
skills.why_zh: 价值在示范：教你把「品牌一致性」写成机器能执行的规则，照抄结构就能做自家版本。
skills.why_en: A worked example of encoding brand consistency as executable rules — copy the structure for your own brand.

skills.name: weekly-digests
skills.tagline_zh: 把项目的全部记忆时间线，按周切开写成连载「项目周记」。
skills.tagline_en: Slices your project's memory timeline into a week-by-week serial digest.
skills.desc_en: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's hist
skills.why_zh: 复盘神器：一个子代理写一周，前情提要自动衔接，读起来像项目的连载小说。
skills.why_en: One subagent per week with running context — your project history reads like a serial.

skills.name: hv-analysis
skills.tagline_zh: 研究一个产品或人物：纵轴讲完整生命史，横轴跟同类横向对比。
skills.tagline_en: Study anything on two axes: its full life story, and a cross-section against peers.
skills.desc_en: 横纵分析法（Horizontal-Vertical Analysis）深度研究Skill。由数字生命卡兹克提出，融合了索绪尔的历时-共时分析、社会科学的纵向-横截面研究设计、商学院案例研究法与竞争战略分析的核心思想。 当用户想要系统性研究一个产品、公司、概念、技术或人物时使用。核心是双轴分析：纵轴追踪从诞生到当下的完整生命历程（以叙事故事呈现），横轴在当下时间截面上与竞品/同类进行系统性横向对比，最后交叉两条轴产出独到洞察。最终产出一份排版精美的PDF研究报告。 触发词包括但不限于：横纵分析、研究一下、帮我分析、深度研究、做个研究、调研一下、竞品分析、帮我看看这个东西怎么样、这个产品/公司/概念是怎么回事、帮我摸清楚、帮我搞懂、帮我做个deep research。 即使用户只是说"帮我了解一下XX"或"XX是什么来头"，只要上下文暗示需要系统性的深度研究（而非简单的概念解释），都应该触发。
skills.why_zh: 把索绪尔的历时-共时、商学院案例法揉成一个可执行套路，产出的研究有骨架不散。
skills.why_en: Saussure's diachronic/synchronic lens fused with case-study method — research with a spine.

skills.name: ponytail
skills.tagline_zh: 请一位「躺平但靠谱」的资深工程师进驻：能不写的代码绝不写。
skills.tagline_en: An unbothered senior engineer moves in: writes no code that needn't exist.
skills.desc_en: Lazy senior dev mode for any coding task (write, refactor, fix, review): YAGNI, stdlib first, no unrequested abstractions. Not for non-coding requests.
skills.why_zh: 反内卷的工程精髓——它总在问「这真的需要做吗」，治过度设计比写代码更省钱。
skills.why_en: Its favorite question is "do we even need this?" — killing overengineering saves more than writing code.

skills.name: design-is
skills.tagline_zh: 用 Dieter Rams 的「好设计十原则」逐条审你的设计，然后给出改造方案。
skills.tagline_en: Audits your design against Rams' ten principles, then hands you a plan.
skills.desc_en: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. skills.why_zh: 审美有了可执行的标尺：不是「感觉不好看」，而是十条原则逐项打分，输出直接接改稿流程。
skills.why_en: Taste with a rubric — ten principles scored one by one, output flows straight into a redesign plan.

skills.name: open-design

skills.why_en: Prototypes, landing pages, dashboards — all local. The most complete free answer to an AI design workbench.

skills.why_zh: 设计交接的痛点被它按住了：设计系统长什么样，一张图谱看明白。
skills.why_en: Design handoff, solved visually — the whole system in one graph.

skills.name: taste-skill
skills.tagline_zh: 往你的 agent 里注入「品味」：设计、审美、克制，三件套。
skills.tagline_en: Inject taste into your agent: design sense, restraint, judgment.
skills.desc_en: Gives your AI good taste. Stops the AI from generating boring, generic slop
skills.why_zh: 它赌品味可以被写下来——那份审美守则读完你会点头，装完输出确实不土了。
skills.why_en: Bets that taste can be written down. Read its rules and you'll nod; install it and outputs stop looking cheap.

skills.name: image-to-code
skills.tagline_zh: 丢一张截图，还原成有品味的代码，而不是像素堆。
skills.tagline_en: Drop a screenshot, get tasteful code back — not a pixel dump.

skills.why_zh: 难点在还原「设计意图」而非像素级复刻，它在这个取舍上做得很聪明。
skills.why_en: Recovers design intent rather than chasing pixel parity — the smart trade-off.

Covers research question formulation, Socratic mentoring, methodology design, systematic literature search, sourc

skills.why_en: A serious open-source take on deep research — the division of labor and cross-checks are well designed.

skills.name: hallmark
skills.tagline_zh: Nutlope 出品的 anti-slop 设计 skill：把「一眼 AI」的页面救回来。
skills.tagline_en: Nutlope's anti-slop design skill — rescues pages from that instant-AI look.

skills.name: prompt-master

Does not activate for general conversation, coding tasks, document writing, or other non-prompt-engineering work.

skills.why_en: A prompt engineer on call; the rewrites are reusable enough to seed a team library.
